description: Qufu Normal University and National Climate Center researchers calculate ten extreme-precipitation indices for the middle and upper Yellow River from station observations during 1961–2020. Quality processing includes unit checks, removal of stations with missing records and interpolation of remaining gaps. The ScienceDB repository lists CSV tables, spatial shapefile components, figures and text documentation, with CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. The indices can help construct historical drought and heavy-rainfall scenarios for water and infrastructure exposure simulations. They are derived summaries, not rainfall event hydrographs, and interpolation introduces uncertainty that should be considered before local design use. No directly related catalogue resource was identified.
